add.issue.name: Timeline bar: tiny section labels (View / Scope / Filter / Play) and the funnel joins Filter

edit.description.md:
The scrubber's controls row separates its groups by gap width alone. Add a small, subtle label above each group, right-aligned: View (layout), Scope (periods + Zoom), Filter (series pickers, text filter) and Play (Live + play). Labels sit in the bar's existing padding so its height grows little or not at all.

Move the funnel (narrow board to window) from the Scope group to the end of the Filter group, after the text filter, matching the collapsed row's order.

The scrubber's controls row separates its groups by gap width alone. Add a small, subtle label above each group, left-aligned: View (layout), Scope (periods, Zoom, funnel), Filter (series pickers, text filter) and Play (Live + play). Labels hang in the panel's top padding, so the bar is no taller, and light with the panel border's own pointer glow.

The funnel stays beside the Scope buttons, nearest the period it holds the board to.
